'''The Virus''' was a [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] criminal partner and bodyguard of [[Cada Bliss]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
In [[3643 BBY]], the Virus and his partner Cada Bliss acquired a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] artifact called the [[Star of Kala'unn]]. Bliss' old enemy [[Vette]] wanted to reclaim it, so she went with [[Darth Baras]]' [[Empire's Wrath|Sith apprentice]] to confront the criminals at the [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]]. Despite putting up a fight, the Virus was killed and his partner Cada was forced to give up the Star of Kala'unn.
